summary: A documentation article using the ca-prose wrapper with headings, two Callouts, a Steps list and a request fields table.
use: Rendering API guide content, with tips, warnings, numbered steps and reference tables, inside a docs page.
spec: Wrapper `<div class="ca-prose prose">` holds plain `h2`, `h3` and `p` elements with ids like `id="demo-auth"`
`<Steps>` wraps an `<ol>` with 2 items: Create a session and Connect with a QR code
Table sits in `<div class="ca-table-wrap" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Request fields">`
Table columns: Field, Type, Description, with 2 rows for `to` and `text`
